Behind the image
05 / Velvet Library
REFERENCE 4574.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 008
Art direction: Amber practical light, historical silhouettes, tactile velvet, careful brooch styling,
subtle film grain.
Original adult woman with long copper-auburn curls, standing before warm softly blurred
bookcases, wearing a tailored dark brown velvet jacket with antique buttons, a high black lace
collar and detailed vintage brooch. Folded arms, calm serious gaze, cinematic tungsten side light,
brass accents, old-world interior, warm brown and amber palette, analog film texture, vertical
period inspired fashion editorial, no text.
06 / Autumn Nocturne
REFERENCE 4916.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 009
Art direction: Diffuse outdoor light, strong dark shape, blurred gold and deep green background,
retro color response.
Vertical cinematic portrait of an original adult woman with long brown hair and natural freckles,
wearing a broad brimmed black hat with dark floral detailing and a high neck black lace blouse.
Looking back at the camera over one shoulder, softly defocused autumn forest, deep green
background and warm golden leaves, quiet expression, diffused daylight, subtle vintage film grain,
low saturation gothic romantic fashion editorial, no text.
